Title: Kratky Hydroponics: No-Pump Setup, Air Gap & Crops
Description: Kratky hydroponics needs no pump: fill once with 1–2 gal of solution per lettuce plant at EC 1.5 and pH 5.5–6.5, leave an air gap and don't top up. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: kratky hydroponic system, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
